title: Two men at the door explain the implant and say Raudive invented it

tellings.quote: then uh he says it was invented by a man named Constantine Raw. And they leave.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with unknown beings, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that a few years ago two men came to the door of his apartment in California. He says they explained an implant, a small object connected to his experiences, told him it was invented by a man named Konstantin Raudive, and then left. If true, it would mean someone knew more about his experiences than he did.
